scenes.heading: Governance
scenes.narration: Governance in Databricks is centralized through Unity Catalog, which manages permissions, lineage, and auditing across the lakehouse.

scenes.heading: Pillars of governance
bullets: Audit logs of who accessed what
scenes.narration: Fine-grained access control lets you grant privileges on catalogs, schemas, and tables to users and groups. Unity Catalog automatically captures lineage, showing how data flows from source to report. And audit logs record who accessed which data, supporting compliance.

scenes.heading: Granting privileges
scenes.narration: Here we grant the analysts group read access to a single table. We grant the engineering group modify rights across an entire schema, which flows down to its tables. The SHOW GRANTS command lets you review exactly who has what access at any time.

scenes.text: Grant privileges to groups, not individuals, and follow least privilege so access stays auditable and easy to manage.
scenes.narration: Grant privileges to groups rather than individuals and follow least privilege, so that access stays auditable and easy to manage.
